verdict.rationale: HubSpot's public Marketing Emails API documents programmatic creation, update and retrieval of marketing emails, which covers the 'create' half of the story. Scheduling a send at a date and time is documented only in the dashboard editor knowledge-base article, so there is no evidence it can be done through the API without the UI. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint for scheduling or sending an email or campaign, an API-level campaign or broadcast object, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API-only workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
